native_to_julia_mapping.reason: Preserve native node words, lane reversal, lock protocol, node/root split operations and warp work queues; same bounded pool through generic allocator interface.

keyconfounds: Named kernels-only scope excludes original main allocation/copy/free region
Generic allocator bounded to1MiB rather than original4GiB; same capacity in all4
Tree shape/allocation IDs/slot order may vary, semantic leaf dictionary canonicalized
Backend CUDA warp/fence/atomic APIs required by KA/JACC
Query counts aligned to32; native final partial warp unguarded write is unmeasured

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Build and search an ordered GPU associative map; infrastructure primitive usable for irregular indexing, not a complete scientific application.
scientific_intent.governing_method: Concurrent B-link tree with warp-cooperative nodes and lock-based splits
accuracy_needs: Every inserted key maps to its original value
No lost or duplicated leaf key records

contract.algorithm: Unchanged native warp B-link insertion/splits/locks and search kernels; all kernel source included
contract.allocator_adaptation: Same pointer arithmetic and atomicAdd allocation; configured smaller capacity through original generic allocator interface, no device-kernel edits.
contract.timing: Sum of two build+search kernel pairs with end sync; allocation/H2D/tree initialization/reset/D2H/canonicalization excluded. Native main end-to-end allocations are not claimed.
contract.scope: Unique 31-bit safe keys/values, 256 and4096 keys, warp-aligned query counts. Native unused delete/range modes not covered. Partial query warp write guard issue remains outside fixture.
contract.output_contract: All query values plus canonicalized complete leaf key/value dictionary; allocator IDs/tree shape/slot order not compared.
